_doc: UI-test av Ignore hair i The Character Creator (tools/studio/ui_test.py): body-gens bikinikvinna med uppstående hästsvans passas in med switchen Ignore hair (skalan efter halsen), och vyn Over visar AI-formen med inpassningens egen skala (base_scale × scale). Några minuter. Skriver assets/characters/ui_test_hair/ och build/human/fit/ui_test_hair/; ta bort dem efteråt. Kör mot studio-test: url med port 8771.
name: creator_hair

steps.label: body-gen's Pixal3D shapes are in the AI shape list

steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#huside select'); s.value = 'build/body/build/pixal3d/body_female_swim.glb'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); document.querySelector('#huside input[type=text]').value = 'ui_test_hair'; const row = [...document.querySelectorAll('#huside .row')].find((r) => r.textContent.includes('Ignore hair')); const box = row.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]'); box.checked = true; box.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); return box.checked; })()

({ ai: __studio.human.lastFit?.ai_transform, start: __studio.human.lastFit?.start?.mean_mm, end: __studio.human.lastFit?.end?.mean_mm, wrap: __studio.human.lastFit?.wrap?.end?.from_ai_mean_mm, ms: __studio.human.lastFit?.ms, msg: [...document.querySelectorAll('#huside .note')].map((n) => n.textContent).filter(Boolean) })

steps.label: Ignore hair reaches the fit: the scale comes from the neck
Over uses the fit's own scale (base_scale × scale)
